name: OPONeRF
definition: A neural rendering method that dynamically conditions the parameters of the plenoptic mapping function on the sampled point's representation to handle test-time scene changes and robustness, unlike vanilla NeRFs where parameters are shared and fixed.
summary: OPONeRF is a neural rendering method that personalizes parameters for each 3D point to handle scene changes, unlike generalizable NeRFs that use fixed parameters.
